notes.title: ENDLESS TENNIS Update
notes.notes:
What if... Tennis... was Endless?
We are celebrating our participation in the Six One Indie Spring Showcase with an exciting new demo update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44927597/010569569c17a342f181f94ec168401e7a3b0d57.gif

New Features

Endless Mode - complete the demo and keep on looping
Tails - each loop will grant you an additional limb slot!
New passive tattoos that trigger limb slots for insane combos
Tattoo Viewbar - easily reference your tattoos in the shop, and stack multiple tattoos
Balance adjustments to Critters, Shells, and more


Thanks for checking out TORSO TENNIS!
- Michael Mato

Visit my website for monthly updates or to find me elsewhere on the internet:
https://www.toomuchtomato.com/

notes.title: The Spooky Update!
notes.notes:
The Spooky Update includes a frighteningly large amount of new content in the Demo. New Limbs, New Bosses, and new Offensive Play options with RIPs. Tattoos are now FREE at the end of each week and you also get the option to tear limbs off of opponents that you defeat!

This is both a huge content and QoL update: Save mid-run and return to the game later. Leave feedback and ideas on the demo. Take ANY LIMB from a defeated opponent and use it to start a new run.

New Limbs: Skull, Bone, Broom, and Tentacle allow you to leave RIPs on the court - literal holes in the fabric of reality. These RIPs serve as weak points where you can direct tennis balls to INSTA-SCORE on your opponent. New Boss Jim Coach will challenge you to hit weak points and barrage you with critter attacks. To top it all off, sport the new fashionable Rib Cage TORSO while you make your way through the demo!

Tune in to the TORSO TENNIS development co-working streams on Twitch to give feedback and join the community: https://www.twitch.tv/toomuchtomato

notes.title: The Shell Update
notes.notes:
Demo Version 0.1.7

A new item type joins the demo!
The demo now features a new item: the SHELL. Dino-type limbs now sometimes will spawn protective items that help you make a more defensive build. You can also now leave a review for the demo~!

Download the update and check out what's new, I also jammed a bunch of item balance changes and quality of life features in.

Leave a Demo Review!
